mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month signals a broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained), the Federal Reserve's policy actions increase borrowing costs and reduce liquidity, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% over three months signals manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200.0 and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and sustained), elevated inflation pressures trigger aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 0.5% over three months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.
